ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: There is a north arrow in the upper right corner of the figure, indicating that north is at the upper part of the map sheet, so the left side of the map sheet corresponds to west and the right side corresponds to east. The river labeled “River 4” in the figure is located in the southern part of the city and extends roughly east-west along the lower part of the map sheet. Reasoning: According to the indication in the figure that River 4 flows from left to right along the lower part, combined with the north arrow, convert “left to right” into actual directions, namely from west to east. Therefore, the flow direction of River 4 is from west to east.

<image1>

What is the flow direction of River 4 in the figure?
